text:
Elena: Heads-up — Skyline Labs QBR scheduled Thu 11am PT. We need a 2-slide token econ summary, 30/60/90 spend forecast, renewal risk callout, and a short enablement checklist. Who can own forecast?
Jorge: I can do the forecast if Priya can pull per-route and per-model agg (last 180d).
Priya: Pulling now. Will include generation vs embed split, top endpoints, and p50/p95 latencies.
billing-bot: Alert: Skyline Labs daily spend spike detected (threshold: $12k/day). Auto-email to admin sent.
Sam: For enablement, I want to propose 3 ops plays: async embedding batches, model pinning to smaller variants during night hours, and a short cache strategy for repeated prompts. Will draft slide.
Elena: Good. Also note renewal touchpoint: account is up for renewal in ~45 days and they've been ramping usage. Add a moderate renewal-risk tag.
Jorge: Quick usage snapshot:
```
period: last_180d
total_tokens: 88,450,000
generation: 59,000,000
embeddings: 29,450,000
model_mix: rwd-4b-q4 (50%), open-13b (20%), embed-lite (30%)
avg_monthly_spend: $34,200
30d_change: +58% (compare to prior 30d)
```
Priya: Uploaded chart pack -> https://drive.redwood.internal/skyline/qbr_pack_v2.csv
Sam: For the checklist, include: (1) identify top 5 endpoints for batching, (2) enable async embed job for near-real-time pipelines, (3) trial int8 on open-13b for non-critical routes.
Elena: Jorge — can you run a quick scenario table: baseline, +20% growth, int8 on open-13b, move embeds to batch? Need estimated $ impact per month.
Jorge: Will run calc. Early estimate: int8 open-13b reduces its token cost by ~34% -> total monthly drops by ~7%. Moving embeds to batch (and using embed-lite batch pricing) could shave another ~10% if we move 60% of embed volume.
Priya: One more datapoint: their traffic peaks at 10am-2pm PT; consider staggered model routing after 2pm to cheaper variants.
Sam: I'll add a slide with an ops timeline for a 6-week cost optimization pilot: week1-diagnostics, week2-batching rollout, week3-int8 test, week4-monitoring, week5-optimizations, week6-retrospective.
Elena: Owners: Jorge = forecast & scenario table, Priya = data + charts, Sam = enablement slides + pilot timeline. I'll handle renewal outreach and the demo/workshop invite.
Jorge: Draft numbers done; adding a small sensitivity table. If growth continues at current pace, burn could hit ~$48k/mo in 30d.
billing-bot: Reminder: next invoice due in 7 days. Consider prepay discount or a short-term committed plan in the QBR options slide.
Priya: Any embed-caching snippets we can reuse? I have a short playbook under /templates/embed_cache_snippet.md — will paste a 3-line snippet in deck.
Sam: Perfect. Also recommend surfacing cost by route in their dashboard so their SREs can triage hot endpoints.
Elena: Can we have a deck draft by Wed EOD? I want to review before outreach.
Jorge: Wed EOD works — will finalize scenario table by then.
Priya: I'll attach latency percentiles and raw CSV by EOD Wed.
Sam: I'll produce the enablement checklist + one-click runbook for their infra team.
Elena: Thanks. Quick CRM note: flag renewal as "engage for cost pilot" in Salesforce after outreach.
Jorge: ack.
Priya: ack.
Sam: ack :rocket:
